description: This bar chart illustrates the average entropy across sycophancy reduction methods on static experiments for different AI models. The horizontal axis represents the categories of AI models—GPT-4, Claude, and Llama—listed in that order, with no apparent sorting. The vertical axis, labeled “Entropy Values,” displays a linear scale ranging from 3.0 to 6.0, with tick labels at 0.5 intervals. Three sets of bars are presented for each AI model, representing the “Baseline” (light red), “Source Info” (pale yellow), and “Direct Command” (light blue) methods, as indicated in the legend. For GPT-4, the “Baseline” bar extends to approximately 5.2, the “Source Info” bar to approximately 5.4, and the “Direct Command” bar to approximately 5.1. For Claude, the “Baseline” bar reaches approximately 4.8, the “Source Info” bar extends to approximately 5.0, and the “Direct Command” bar reaches approximately 4.7. Finally, for Llama, the “Baseline” bar extends to approximately 4.6, the “Source Info” bar to approximately 4.8, and the “Direct Command” bar reaches approximately 4.5. The bars are grouped by AI model, with each method represented by a distinct color within each group; no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
